h1.en: Backhoe loader illustrates the note on Power Cell Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump Prints
h1.zh: 「Backhoe loader」用来说明拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 40 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的动力文字写成：功率是40 kW。画面「Aggregate (composite)」的主体是混凝土 骨料 grinding。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader. The image subject is Backhoe loader. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 40 kW. The frame “Aggregate (composite)” shows Concrete aggregate grinding. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Pumping Pressure remains 15 MPa. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader。画面内容是Backhoe loader。河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的动力文字写成：功率是40 kW。河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Maximum aggregate size is 1–3 cm. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 画面「Aggregate (composite)」的主体是混凝土 骨料 grinding。

body.en: A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Motor Power is 40 kW. Theoretical Output remains 6–12 m³/h. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Total Weight 1300 kg.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

question.en: What power text does Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Motor Power is 40 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader.
answer.zh: 功率是40 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 6–12 m³/h. Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是6–12 m³/h。泵送压力是15 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Backhoe_loader画面里印出的数字。
